steps.text: Get membership either with a bond or irl money

steps.title: Transfer about 100-200m gp and a …
steps.text: Transfer about 100-200m gp and a ring of wealth (5) to your account(s) (200m+ if you are doing inquis helm route)

steps.title: Teleport to Grand Exchange with ring …
steps.text: Teleport to Grand Exchange with ring of wealth

steps.title: Buy some teleports, runes for early …
steps.text: Buy some teleports, runes for early questing

steps.title: buy some bones for 70 prayer …
steps.text: buy some bones for 70 prayer (or higher)
steps.note: Offer bones at a gilded altar in a POH with both incense burners lit (fastest); Chaos altar in the Wilderness is ~half the cost.

steps.title: Get 43 prayer or go to …
steps.text: Get 43 prayer or go to 70 if you feel like it (wildy or 330 poh)
steps.note: Offer bones at a gilded altar in a POH with both incense burners lit (fastest); Chaos altar in the Wilderness is ~half the cost.
